operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline && pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow docs/backup-and-restore.md. Export the practice before migration, preserve the exact source, applied SQL bytes and private vault key, restore into an empty installation, supply the latest erasure journal, recreate excluded sign-in accounts and agent keys, then re-export and compare the restored practice before routing traffic.
